# ghost/wellbeing

Digital Wellbeing: today's screen time, per-app usage, set or remove a daily app timer. No account.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/wellbeing
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/wellbeing get_screen_time_today --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/wellbeing list_app_usage --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/wellbeing set_app_timer --device <serial> --param app=<app> --param minutes=<minutes>
ghost skill run ghost/wellbeing remove_app_timer --device <serial> --param app=<app>
```

## Actions

- `get_screen_time_today`: How much screen time have I had today?
- `list_app_usage`: Which apps did I use most today?
- `set_app_timer`: Limit Clock to 30 minutes a day
- `remove_app_timer`: Remove the app timer on Clock
